text:
maya: seeing a weird pattern in streaming metrics — tenants with small bursty traffic are getting double-charged on resume + replay. console shows resume credits bouncing.
raj: hmm, seen anything in proxy logs? or is this a console aggregation bug?
maya: quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-04-12T14:02:11Z] conn=abc123 resume_id=rid-9 attempts=1 X-Resume-Credit=10
[2026-04-12T14:02:12Z] conn=def456 resume_id=rid-9 attempts=2 X-Resume-Credit=10
[2026-04-12T14:02:14Z] conn=ghi789 resume_id=rid-9 attempts=3 X-Resume-Credit=10
```
maya: proxy is issuing the same resume credit on rapid reconnects, but console shows three separate resume events and billing math treats them as independent.
tess: that sounds like a dedupe window miss — we de-dupe resume events by resume_id but only within a 1s window on the collector side; these reconnects are spaced ~2s apart so they fall out.
raj: why are reconnects happening that often? client jitter? or server keepalive tear-down?
maya: small clients with flaky mobile links. we purposely smoothed credits so a single resume gives N tokens of free replay (to avoid tiny retries incurring full cost). smoothing should prevent charging when it's the same logical stream.
oliver: console is currently summing resume_count events and dividing out credits per resume event; if collector emits three events we show 3x. we could change console to read X-Resume-Credit header and compute effective credit by grouping resume_id, but that means console needs access to the raw header metric which it doesn't today.
tess: ops question: is it safe to extend dedupe window on collector from 1s->5s? risk is suppressing legitimate separate resumes for different connections that happen to reuse resume_id?
raj: resume_id uniqueness guarantee is per client session; reused ids are rare but possible on client reconnects if they rollover. increasing to 5s seems low risk and would catch most flapping cases.
maya: alternative: add a "resume_credit_granularity" metric that tags the resume event with the credit amount and a monotonic resume_seq so console can aggregate correctly without changing dedupe windows. lighter touch, but needs a small telemetry schema bump.
oliver: that is preferable for console UX. but it requires collector to pass header->metric and console dashboards to be patched. timeline?
tess: short term -> roll collector change to emit X-Resume-Credit as resume_credit tag and include resume_id. then update console pipeline to group by resume_id and sum resume_credit. no changes to billing pipeline yet.
raj: also worth adding server-side jitter enforcement: when we see 3 resumes within 10s for same resume_id, temporarily refuse resume for 1s and return `X-Resume-Suppressed: true` to help clients backoff and avoid billing.
maya: can we return a 202 with body {"status":"suppressed"} so SDKs can surface better messaging?
tess: prefer header-only to avoid changing streaming semantics; we can emit `X-Resume-Suggested-Backoff: 1000` and SDK will show a toast if implemented.
oliver: I'll add a console tile to surface suppressed resumes per tenant (new metric `resume.suppressed_count`) so SRE + customers can see it.
raj: I'll draft collector PR to: 1) emit resume_credit tag, 2) bump dedupe window to 5s, 3) add suppressed badge when we suppress within short window.
maya: thanks. can we also log a sample trace id when suppression triggers so we can inspect end-to-end in honeycomb?
raj: yes I'll attach trace.trace_id=... in suppression log line.
sre-bot: deploy scheduled: collector/metrics-emitter v2.14 -> staging at 2026-04-13T01:00:00Z, canary to prod afterwards. :rocket:
maya: sounds good. once collector is in staging, oliver can tweak dashboard query to use `sum(resume_credit) by (tenant, resume_id)` and a fallback that shows `resume_count` until the migration is done.
oliver: ack, will put a console change request and a small migration doc in product-dashboards.
tess: follow-up action items:
- raj: PR to collector + tests (due EOD)
- oliver: dashboard patch + migration plan (due +2d)
- maya: add SDK issue to respect X-Resume-Suggested-Backoff (low priority)
- tess: monitor suppressed_count and resume_credit ratio after rollout
maya: thanks all, this should stop customers from getting charged 2-3x for the same logical resume. we should also add a note to billing FAQ about transient resume suppression so support can triage.
